Name: (CP) Chipmunks
Author: macro191
Description:
[b][center][/center][/b][center][size=4][b][/b][/size][/center][center][size=5][b][/b][/size][/center][center][size=6][b]🐿️ [CP] Chipmunk — A Forest Friend for Your Coop[/b][/size]
[i]By Macro191[/i][/center]

[center]﻿[/center][center][b]Final Update Note
[/b]Hey everyone,
This will be my final update for this mod. I want to thank everyone who has used it—it was truly created as a fun side project, and I'm glad it resonated with some of you.
Unfortunately, I've found that some in the modding community can be a little unwelcoming to newcomers, which has diminished my enthusiasm for continuing development
That said, the mod will remain available as-is. If anyone wants to take it over or continue development, feel free to reach out.
Thanks for everything![/center]



Bring a dash of the woodland to your farm! This mod introduces the [b]Chipmunk[/b] as a fully functional, highly customizable coop animal. From seasonal foraging to rare genetic variants, these little critters offer a dynamic, cozy alternative to the standard chicken.

[size=4][b]✨ Features at a Glance[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]New Animal:[/b] The Chipmunk! A small, high-energy addition to any coop.
[*] [b]Dynamic Foraging:[/b] They don't just produce eggs—they find seasonal "treasures" that change with the weather.
[*] [b]Elder Chipmunks:[/b] An optional, prestigious variant exclusive to the [b]Deluxe Coop[/b].
[*] [b]Rare Color Variants:[/b] Discover the elusive Albino, Melanistic, and Golden chipmunks, each with their own unique loot tables.
[*] [b]Winter Hibernation:[/b] A toggleable realism mode where your chipmunks sleep through the frost.
[*] [b]Deep Customization:[/b] Choose your own gameplay balance, from "Bountiful" to "Hardcore" challenges.
[/list]

[size=4][b]🌈 Meet the Rare Variants[/b][/size]
If [i]EnableVariants[/i] is set to true, you may encounter these special friends in the shop:
[list]
[*] [b]Albino Chipmunk (1500g):[/b] Finds delicate, high-quality foraged items.
[*] [b]Melanistic Chipmunk (1300g):[/b] A dark-furred scout that unearths hidden treasures.
[*] [b]Golden Chipmunk (3000g):[/b] [i]Requires Deluxe Coop.[/i] Finds luxury items like Truffle Oil and Golden Feathers.
[/list]

[size=4][b]⚙️ Configuration & Balance[/b][/size]
Tailor the mod to your playstyle via the [i]config.json[/i] or [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]:
[list]
[*] [b]Balance Presets:[/b] 
--- [i]Bountiful:[/i] High rewards, low cost. Great for a relaxed farm.--- [i]Vanilla:[/i] Perfectly balanced for the standard Stardew economy.--- [i]Hardcore:[/i] For players who want to earn every single gold piece.[*] [b]Produce Styles:[/b] Choose between [i]Balanced, Rich,[/i] or [i]Forager[/i] to determine what your chipmunks bring home.
[*] [b]Breeding:[/b] Toggle whether you want a chipmunk baby boom or a controlled population.
[/list]

[size=4][b]🛠️ Installation & Requirements[/b][/size]
[b]Required:[/b]
1. [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (Latest)
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[b]Recommended:[/b]
* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15366]Extra Animal Config[/url] — For even more control over animal behavior.
[b]Instructions:[/b]
1. Download and unzip [i][CP] Chipmunk[/i].
2. Place the folder into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] directory.
3. Launch the game and enjoy your new forest friends!

[size=4][b]⚠️ Compatibility & Support[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Version:[/b] Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+.
[*] [b]Conflicts:[/b] Works with most mods. It uses unique internal IDs to prevent overwriting vanilla animals.
[*] [b]Uninstalling:[/b] If you remove this mod mid-save, sell your chipmunks first to avoid "missing data" errors.
[/list]
[i]When reporting issues, please include your SMAPI log and mod list![/i]
